title: Family

story.title: A Sunday with my big family
story.text: My name is Dilnoza and I live in Samarkand with my **parents** and my little brother. I’m not an **only child**, but sometimes I feel like one because my brother is ten years younger! | Every Sunday, all our **relatives** **get together** at my **grandparents’** house. My grandma is very **kind** and **calm**. She **looks after** everyone and cooks a huge plov. My grandpa is a bit **strict**, but he is also really **funny**. | My aunt comes with her **husband** and their **twins**, Ali and Vali. They are my favourite **cousins**. I **get on well with** them because we **grew up** together. My uncle and his **wife** bring my **niece**, little Madina. Everyone says she **looks like** me! | My grandparents are very proud. They have five **grandsons** and three **granddaughters**. My parents **got married** twenty years ago, and they are still very **close**. My dad is a **hard-working** engineer. | I love Sundays because our family is loud, happy and full of love.
tf: The family meets at the grandparents’ house every Sunday.
Dilnoza doesn’t get on well with her cousins.

answers: Who are you closest to? Why?
I’m **closest to** my mum. She’s very **kind** and she always listens to me. When I have a problem, I talk to her first.
How often do you see your relatives?
Quite often! **Every Sunday** our relatives **get together** at my grandparents’ house. We eat plov and talk for hours.
speech: Good morning! I’d like to tell you about my family. **There are five of us**: my parents, my two younger sisters and me. **I’m the oldest.** **My dad works as an** engineer and my mum is a teacher. **Everyone says I look like** my dad – we’re both tall and calm. I **get on well with** my sisters, but **we sometimes argue** about the TV! **I’m closest to** my mum because she’s so kind. **At the weekend we usually** visit our grandparents and all our relatives get together. Family is very important to me. Thank you!

end: That’s why I love my family.
